scoring_justification: The integer counts are deterministic from the paper's explicit formulas; the checker recomputes the exact integers and compares row-by-row.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold expected row values for nc_formulas_values.csv
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's explicit formulas (Eqs. 2-39) and Tables III, IV, V
hidden_assets.generation_method: Checker recomputes exact integer values from the formulas (same as reference solve.sh)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The formulas are the paper's main result; the gold is the deterministic evaluation of those formulas, which is the reproduction target.

outputs.description: CSV containing the computed integer counts of atoms, bonds, and interface bonds for each zinc-blende nanocrystal shape, subclass, and size index i=1..7.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker reimplements the explicit formulas from the paper and compares each row's integer values exactly. All rows must match exactly for full credit.

steps.description: Exact integer match of all rows against gold derived from paper formulas.
